title: Tangent spaces of the image of a C¹ map with a continuous affine left inverse are the ranges of its derivatives
statement: Let d, P ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P, let L : ℝ^P → ℝ^d be a continuous linear map, and let z ∈ ℝ^P and s ∈ ℝ. Let D := B_s(0) ⊆ ℝ^d be the open ball. Assume Φ is of class C¹ on D and L(Φ(v) − z) = v for every v ∈ D. Put Σ := Φ(D). Then for every v₀ ∈ D, the contract's tangent space tangentSpace Σ (Φ(v₀)) equals the range of DΦ(v₀) = fderiv ℝ Φ v₀, regarded as a linear map and coerced to a set. Here tangentSpace Σ (Φ(v₀)) is the set of vectors w such that some γ : ℝ → ℝ^P is C¹ on (−1, 1), maps (−1, 1) into Σ, has γ(0) = Φ(v₀), and has HasDerivAt γ w 0. ℝ^m denotes Euclid m = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m).
lean_statement: ∀ (d P : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid d) (z : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ (ball 0 s) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid d) s, L (Φ v - z) = v) → ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid d) s, tangentSpace (Φ '' ball (0 : Euclid d) s) (Φ v) = (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ v : Euclid d →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) : Set (Euclid P))
